cameraFit.scope: Normal idle, native Attack, selected native hit frames, and selected native death frames in one fresh isolated V2 combat session.
cameraFit.comparison: The V1 archive remains immutable and rejected because its taller scale cropped the upper body. V2 changes only the profile visualScale from 1.0 to 0.55 while reusing identical original GLB and palette bytes.

materialReview.scope: Runtime inventory and native combat camera review.
materialReview.result: The exact renderer reports the authored Sablevine palette with native emission disabled. The selected frames show distinct green, cyan, and dark palette bands across a readable connected serpent form. This accepts limited combat-camera fit, not final art direction.

selectedPNGs.observation: Normal native combat idle frames the whole serpent: crown, head, body, and base remain inside the camera with a readable connected silhouette.
A later idle sample retains the complete upper silhouette and the colored segmented body; the V1 upper-body crop is absent at this corrected scale.
The exact native Attack trigger is recorded at this transition. The entire custom silhouette remains inside the combat framing despite motion blur.
The native bite attack deforms the bound serpent coherently while keeping head, crown, body, and base in camera.
Attack follow-through keeps the same visible custom renderer and full practical silhouette in normal combat framing.
The ordinary player Damaged trigger is recorded. The hit effect briefly occupies the frame, but the exact renderer stays present and scaled.
The native hit clip keeps the authored body connected; effects limit fine art inspection during this moment.
Later hit recovery retains the exact scaled renderer and a coherent snake body without the V1 framing crop.
The separate explicit fixture records the native Death trigger while the complete bound model remains visible.
The native death pose settles as a coherent flattened serpent body on the floor; this is animator-driven fixture evidence, not ragdoll evidence.
A later death sample retains the connected defeated form before victory UI progression.

v1Reference.relationship: Same original asset bytes at the rejected V1 profile scale; V2 preserves V1 and proves the fresh 0.55 profile correction separately.

limits: This review covers the exact enbaseysnake / snakeJungleA / enSnake_Basey source pair only; direct Jungle Snake rows and sibling resource-prefab routes require their own trials.
V2 accepts camera fit only for the scale-only public profile correction in the selected isolated combat route. The V1 rejection remains immutable historical evidence.
The ordinary hit is nonlethal; the separate explicit KillSingle transition is not ordinary lethal-damage acceptance.
The native death clip remains animator-driven and no rigidbodies were recorded, so this is not a ragdoll or settled-corpse review.
Portraits, culling envelope, collision, long-session resource lifetime, other native ability variants, and final art-direction approval remain separate work.
